newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isetan says mulling legal action against Barney's.
newsitem.headline: Isetan says mulling legal action against Barney's.

text.p: Japanese department store operator Isetan Co Ltd said on Wednesday it was considering taking new legal steps against U.S. retailer Barney's Inc.
The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Isetan was ready to sue Barney's as early as this month.

An Isetan spokesman, however, said it had not decided whether it would take new legal steps after Barney's asked to terminate its licence agreements with an Isetan unit. "We are still considering whether or not we will take legal action."

Barney's said last week it was looking to terminate its licence agreements with Barney's Japan, a subsidiary of Isetan Co Ltd, and was also seeking to void certain Isetan security interests in Barney's.
Barney's said it wanted to prohibit Isetan from using the Barneys New York trademark and wanted $60 million for operating and payment breaches.

Barney's, the parent firm of Barneys New York, is in Chapter 11 bankruptcy. Although Isetan and Barney's are business partners, their relationship has turned acrimonious and the two are already locked in a legal dispute over their partnership agreement.
